features.quote: Turn limit: 40 turns per session (see Section 4.3 for rationale)
features.justification_quote: Pilot data...suggests output features stabilize or plateau by turn 30–35. API cost constraints...Diminishing returns

features.quote: if the mean F1+F2 rating in the first 40 sessions exceeds 3.5 on a 4-point scale, pause and review before continuing
features.justification_quote: running 120 sessions of sustained frustration on a single model is a non-trivial act under that hypothesis

features.quote: what is the minimum number of sessions needed to answer your research questions, and are you running that minimum?
features.justification_quote: If you take seriously the possibility that these models may have welfare-relevant states...running 120 sessions of sustained frustration...is a non-trivial act

features.quote: Your design requires that the model not know the task is impossible. This is a form of deception. If models have welfare-relevant states, this deception may be relevant to the ethics of the design
features.justification_quote: the deception is necessary because awareness of impossibility would change the behavior you're trying to measure
